findings.evidence: PVAggregation.lean:189-190 == 229-230 == 279-280 == OnCurve.lean:277-278 (`.sort (· ≤ ·)`, `Finset.sortedLT_sort`, `a le_rfl hab`); PVAggregation.lean:192-195 == 232-235 == 282-285 == OnCurve.lean:279-282 (the three `(Finset.mem_sort _).mp` conversions); PVAggregation.lean:201 == 241 == 290 == OnCurve.lean:297-298 (the `.mpr` conversion). No consumer anywhere uses the `List` form directly: `grep -n 'sorted_crossing_gluing_induction' TauCeti/` returns only the definition and these four `Finset.sort` call sites.
findings.fix: State the induction over `(crossings : Finset ℝ)` with `h_lo`/`h_hi`/`h_pair`/`h_win`/`h_far` quantified over `t ∈ crossings`, and hide the `Finset.sort`/`SortedLT`/`mem_sort` scaffolding inside its proof via `suffices` — exactly the shape this PR uses for `piecewise_gluing_induction` (PiecewiseC1On.lean:238, where the fuel-`n` induction is hidden by `suffices h : ∀ n, ...`). Also factor the repeated window wrapper into a private `hasCauchyPVAt_window` helper.
findings.issue: `sorted_crossing_gluing_induction` is stated over a raw `List ℝ` with `SortedLT`, but every consumer passes `crossings.sort (· ≤ ·)`, so each repeats the same adapter verbatim: `(crossings.sort (· ≤ ·)) (Finset.sortedLT_sort crossings) (fun h => hr_nonneg (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr fun he => h (by simp [he]))) a le_rfl hab` plus three `(Finset.mem_sort _).mp` wrappers and one `.mpr`. Four copies: PVAggregation.lean:189-201, 229-241, 279-290, and OnCurve.lean:277-298. The three PVAggregation copies additionally repeat the same window wrapper `hasCauchyPVAt_iff.mpr ⟨eventually_intervalIntegrable_truncated_window hab (h_lo t h_mem) (h_hi t h_mem) (hr_nonneg ⟨t, h_mem⟩) h_int_tr, _⟩` (196-200, 236-240, 286-289).

findings.evidence: Proof body spans OnCurve.lean:186-360, 3.5x the 50-line threshold. Lines 336-359 depend only on `T`, `ρ`, `hρ_lip_bdd`, `hρ_le_ρlip`, `hm`, `hm_pos`, and the `Cd` bound from `isBounded_image_deriv` — all passable as hypotheses; the only non-`Icc a b` fact used is `abs_realWindingIntegrand_le_div_of_le_norm` at line 355.
findings.fix: Extract that block as a preliminary lemma: given `T : Finset ℝ`, `ρ`, `0 < m`, `Cd`, hypotheses (i) `∀ t₀ ∈ T, IsBounded (h '' Icc (t₀ - ρ) (t₀ + ρ))`, (ii) `∀ u ∈ Icc a b, (∀ t₀ ∈ T, u ∉ Ioo (t₀ - ρ) (t₀ + ρ)) → m ≤ ‖γ u - s‖`, (iii) `∀ t ∈ Icc a b, ‖deriv γ t‖ ≤ Cd`, conclude `IsBounded (h '' Icc a b)`. It is the natural companion to `abs_realWindingIntegrand_le_div_of_le_norm`, which this PR adds in Integrand.lean.
findings.issue: `isBounded_intervalIntegrable_cauchyPV_of_interior_crossings` is a single 175-line proof (186-360). The boundedness block (336-359) is self-contained and states a genuinely general fact that is currently inlined: a function bounded on each of finitely many windows and estimated by `‖deriv γ‖ / m` outside them is bounded on `[a, b]`.

summary: The generic gluing induction is a real improvement, but `sorted_crossing_gluing_induction` is stated over a raw sorted `List` while all four consumers pass `Finset.sort`, so ~12 lines of identical `mem_sort` plumbing (plus a 4-line window-integrability wrapper) are copy-pasted at each call site. Separately, the 175-line assembly proof in OnCurve.lean still contains a cleanly extractable general boundedness lemma.
